title: Proposed a shared knowledge layer for AI agents
summary: With a program leader, I proposed a governed, permission-aware layer of engineering context that every AI agent can share, so each tool stops rebuilding its own.
what_would_have_happened: Each AI tool would build and govern its own copy of the same context.
the_call: Invest once in a shared, governed layer.
what_i_did: Co-wrote the proposal with its candidate team, use cases and budget, and started talks with another business about reusing the layer for document generation.
